diagramize preview

Each Mermaid kind as diagramize draws it. HTML pages use mermaid-light.json on a light page and mermaid-dark.json on a dark page, and switch when the viewer's colour scheme does. Markdown files always use mermaid-light.json, because a Markdown block cannot follow the viewer's colour scheme.

flowchart

Source: flowchart.mmd
flowchart TD
    A(["request arrives"]) --> B{"token expired?"}
    B -->|"no"| E["forward request"]
    B -->|"yes"| C["refresh token (new)"]
    C --> D{"refresh ok?"}
    D -->|"yes"| E
    D -->|"no"| F(["return 401"])
    E --> S[("session store")]

sequence

Source: sequence.mmd
sequenceDiagram
    participant U as User
    participant C as CLI
    participant A as API
    participant W as Worker
    U->>C: run job
    C->>A: POST /jobs
    A->>W: enqueue
    A-->>C: 202, id
    C-->>U: id
    loop every 5 s, until done
        C->>A: GET /jobs/id
    end
    alt job done
        A-->>C: result
    else job failed
        W-xA: report failure
        A-->>C: error
    end
    Note over A,W: the worker retries up to 3 times

state

Source: state.mmd
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> idle
    idle --> running: start
    running --> finished: done
    running --> retrying: fail
    retrying --> running: retry, up to 3
    retrying --> failed: give up
    finished --> [*]
    failed --> [*]

class

Source: class.mmd
classDiagram
    class Backend {
        <<interface>>
        +put(key, data) void
        +get(key) bytes
    }
    class S3Backend {
        -string bucket
    }
    class GcsBackend {
        -string project
    }
    Backend <|.. S3Backend
    Backend <|.. GcsBackend
    class Uploader {
        +upload(file) id
    }
    Uploader --> Backend : stores blobs in
